rationale: The observed curves for landmark_00 and landmark_01 (dx, dy, dz, soft_mass) all show transient, non-monotone contrasts concentrated in the early-to-middle portion of the observed score window [0.0,0.49], with recovery toward baseline late; polynomial fits were rejected and sign conflicts are numerous, so the timing is a hypothesis rather than a discovered stage. C1_robust_to_base applies larger delta (0.5 -> 0.75 -> 1.0) early and relaxes to baseline curvature later, matching the direction of the observed early-to-middle contrasts while keeping dose, teachers, temperatures and eta frozen. C2_constant_curvature is the timing control with the same discrete mean delta, and C3 is the opposite-timing control; C1 is the registered choice that tests whether the observed early contrast is a useful control signal. This is an empirical post-native reward-schedule edit, not an exact tilted-density sample, and no current outcome or decoded-affinity labels are available in this role input.
